item.author: @tldraw
item.description:
If you rotate a 100×50 rectangle by 45°, its bounding box grows to roughly 106×106.

That might seem wasteful, but it’s deliberate. Axis-aligned boxes can be checked for overlap with four comparisons. Rotated ones need the separating axis theorem and a lot more math.
